evidence.reason: The TimeoutExpired path in invoke() now writes the same best-effort session.json link before returning the typed budget stop, taking the current sessionId only from files this invocation created (mirroring the existing writer, whose _atomic import was hoisted for shared use), so a wall-clock kill after cq created a session leaves its link while a deferred rung reusing the directory never claims an earlier run's session; tests were not run (harness allows only git commands), but the owned diff was inspected against the existing timeout tests in test_cq_wall_clock_budget.py and test_session_log_preservation.py, which assert only report/log fields and remain satisfied.
